topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Rain's been hammering down like it's trying to punch its way inside. Last thing I need is some uppity neighbor thinking now's the perfect time to slap up a fence. Like I don't have enough to think about, with the way the city eats its own when the dark comes. This fence ain't solving anything. It's just another line in the sand, another reminder of what's mine and what ain't. People talk about boundaries, but this? This is more than just a piece of wood. It's them saying they don't trust what's right next door. Well, they got a point, don't they? Don't expect I'll be the one to wave it through with a smile. Not tonight.
